title: Flying craft in ancient Indian texts
summary: Steven Greer tells of Flying craft in ancient Indian texts, about ancient at India, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Oh absolutely the Bhagavagita and the ancient themanas.

plain: A UFO researcher named Steven Greer, on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that ancient Indian scriptures such as the Bhagavad Gita and the Vedas describe vimanas, flying craft. If true, it would mean people saw advanced flying machines thousands of years ago.
